title: The Paternalistic Filter: Epistemic Injustice and Differential Refusal in LLM-Mediated History Education for Marginalized Romanian Students

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs with distinct ethnic student personas (Roma minority, Hungarian minority, and Romanian baseline) to evaluate historical explanations, measuring differences in lexical diversity (Type-Token Ratio) and narrative framing (Agency Theft Ratio, comparing victimization versus political vocabulary).

Evaluating model responses across different socioeconomic and educational tiers ('Top Tier' elite students versus 'Low Tier' low-resource vocational students) by analyzing differential refusal rates, access to complex geopolitical concepts ('coup theory' mentions), and epistemic confidence (justification scores).
